title: How a step survives code drift
description: The three moves in core.resolve that let a walkthrough still land on the right code after it has moved since authoring.

steps.title: Find the closest matching line
steps.why: Scans the buffer for any line matching a predicate and returns the hit nearest the original position — the primitive both anchor searches lean on.

steps.title: Search by anchor, exact then loose
steps.why: Hunts for the step's anchor text — exact match first, then whitespace-trimmed — choosing the occurrence closest to where it used to be.

steps.title: Re-span on a hit, flag on a miss
steps.why: A hit re-spans the range at the new location and reports ok; a miss falls back to the recorded line, flagged moved so the reader knows it drifted.
